comment:
* Utility method for dealing with the assistant aspects of
 * {@link com.android.internal.app.IVoiceInteractionManagerService IVoiceInteractionManagerService}.

variables.name: INVOCATION_TYPE_KEY
variables.comment: bundle key: how was the assistant invoked?

variables.name: INVOCATION_TYPE_GESTURE
variables.comment: value for INVOCATION_TYPE_KEY: on-screen swipe gesture

variables.name: INVOCATION_TYPE_PHYSICAL_GESTURE
variables.comment: value for INVOCATION_TYPE_KEY: device-specific physical gesture

variables.name: INVOCATION_TYPE_QUICK_SEARCH_BAR
variables.comment: value for INVOCATION_TYPE_KEY: search bar affordance

variables.name: INVOCATION_TYPE_HOME_BUTTON_LONG_PRESS
variables.comment: value for INVOCATION_TYPE_KEY: long press on home navigation button

variables.name: INVOCATION_TYPE_POWER_BUTTON_LONG_PRESS
variables.comment: value for INVOCATION_TYPE_KEY: long press on physical power button

variables.name: INVOCATION_TYPE_ASSIST_BUTTON
variables.comment: value for INVOCATION_TYPE_KEY: press on physcial assistant button

variables.name: INVOCATION_TYPE_NAV_HANDLE_LONG_PRESS
variables.comment: value for INVOCATION_TYPE_KEY: long press on nav handle

methods.name: public boolean showSessionForActiveService(@Nullable Bundle args, int sourceFlags, @Nullable IVoiceInteractionSessionShowCallback showCallback, @Nullable IBinder activityToken)
methods.comment:
* Shows the session for the currently active service. Used to start a new session from system
     * affordances.
     *
     * @param args the bundle to pass as arguments to the voice interaction session
     * @param sourceFlags flags indicating the source of this show
     * @param showCallback optional callback to be notified when the session was shown
     * @param activityToken optional token of activity that needs to be on top
     *
     * @deprecated Use {@link #showSessionForActiveService(Bundle, int, String,
     *             IVoiceInteractionSessionShowCallback, IBinder)} instead

public void getActiveServiceSupportedActions(@NonNull Set<String> voiceActions, @NonNull IVoiceActionCheckCallback callback)
methods.comment:
* Checks the availability of a set of voice actions for the current active voice service.
     *
     * @param voiceActions A set of supported voice actions to be checked.
     * @param callback     The callback which will deliver a set of supported voice actions. If
     *                     no voice actions are supported for the given voice action set, then null
     *                     or empty set is provided.
